assumptions: IMGT/GENE-DB's own per-label translations define the domains.
limits: Names the isotype from sequence; it does not infer effector function.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: The answer is the best-matching IMGT constant gene and allele with its identity and domain placements, which the outputs carry; the Antibody panel shows them on the chain diagram and writes no reading over them.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which immunoglobulin gene and allele is this chain's constant region, and where does each IMGT domain sit on it?

description: Name the CONSTANT region of an antibody chain: which immunoglobulin gene and allele it carries (IGHG1, IGHA2, IGKC, IGLC2 …), and where each IMGT domain sits on it — CH1, the hinge, CH2, CH3, the secretory tail and the membrane exons, or the single C region of a light chain. A domain search says 'a C1-set immunoglobulin domain'; this says which isotype it is. Reads IMGT/GENE-DB's own per-label translations for every species, and is graded against UniProtKB's curated human constant chains and their CH1/hinge/CH2/CH3 regions.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

minIdentity.description: a domain matching less of its reference than this is not reported.

protein.description: the chain (one-letter amino acids); the constant region in it is found, so a whole heavy chain is fine.

species.description: only consider genes of this species, spelled as IMGT spells it (Homo sapiens, Mus musculus). Left out, every species in the catalogue competes and the answer says which won.

name: antibody_isotype

allele.description: the allele, as IMGT numbers them (01)

domains.description: each IMGT label placed on the chain: label, start, end (1-based inclusive), identity, coverage

gene.description: the IMGT gene the constant region matches (IGHG1)

identity.description: identical residues over every aligned column, 0 to 1
